title: SEBI Proposes Common Advertisement Code (CAC) Under Intermediaries Regulations 2008
summary: Replaces separate exchange ad rules with single code and 24-hour post-publication reporting.

blocks.content: Replaces separate exchange ad rules with single code and 24-hour post-publication reporting.

items: Harmonised Code: Single Common Advertisement Code applies to stockbrokers, MFs, PMs, RAs, and IAs.
Post-Reporting SLA: Mandates reporting of advertisements within 24 hours of publication instead of prior clearance.
Celebrity Endorsements: Permits brand-level celebrity endorsements while prohibiting specific product/service endorsements.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: PaRRVA (Past Risk and Return Verification Agency) ratings permitted under proposed CAC.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Ad reporting SLA (24 hours after publication) vs celebrity endorsement scope (brand-level only).
